title: Polynomial maps which are not good for nice recurrence and applications
summary: Let $\mathbb F_2$ be the finite field with two elements and let $\mathbb F_2^ω$ denote the countably infinite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$. We show that, unlike the case of polynomial maps $p:\mathbb Z\rightarrow\mathbb Z$ vanishing at zero which are always good for nice recurrence, there are polynomials $p:\mathbb F_2^ω\rightarrow \mathbb F_2^ω$ with $p(0_{\mathbb F_2^ω})=0_{\mathbb F_2^ω}$ which fail to have this property.
